races.p: Brown, who called Husted the face of data centers, won. Husted led the Senate push for the Ratepayer Protection Act, which failed 57–43. One group notes only 3% of Ohio Senate voters named data centers as their top issue, so how much it decided the race is contested.

Hinojosa ran on an immediate moratorium and ending tax breaks and takes office Jan. 19. Abbott's permit freeze and ERCOT audit carry to then; the Legislature appears divided, which limits how far a pause can go.

Acton backs a conditional moratorium until data centers cover their own costs; Ramaswamy's day-one order pledge is moot. Most of her plan needs the Republican legislature. The canvass takes about three weeks.

races.h: Pennsylvania governor: Shapiro (D) reelected over Garrity (R)
races.p: Shapiro keeps his August permit conditions, which require local approval before state permits. Democrats also flipped the state Senate, giving him a trifecta for 2027 cost and siting bills.

races.h: Georgia Public Service Commission: Democrats flip it 3–2
races.p: Peter Hubbard and Shelia Edwards won both seats on the ballot, the first Democratic majority in about 30 years. The panel sets Georgia Power's rates and decides on its data center plans.

races.h: House races built around data centers
races.p: Democrats flipped PA-8 (Cognetti over Bresnahan), PA-7 and CO-8, and Kaptur held OH-9 over Merrin. Opened sources do not tie each result to data centers specifically.
